what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: AU Hawk
summary: The lower undertray is separated from arch-raised side lips, removing the curved radial underside ramps. Raised painted door moulding, tucked flanks and the reference spoiler improve the shaded body. Hawk-style atlas wheels retain broad silver five-spoke faces with sealed inner sidewalls; windscreen/backlight detail uses the existing atlas. Exported triangles are 2096 / 880 / 600 within unchanged 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. Weighted silhouette scores are 0.9595 / 0.9579 / 0.9510; the LOD2 top view remains 0.9377. Original physical contracts, pivots, colliders, anchors and handling are unchanged. Named corrective checks pass; grille/bumper recess depth and lamp/mirror detail remain coarser than the reference. This is awaiting artistic review, not full production qualification.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Unchanged generated reference sheets and frozen fit cameras. The comparison directories contain reference/shaded/diff sheets at every LOD; lod-reference-review.png includes rear heroes. visual-comparison.png uses identical fixed world cameras and scale for previous/current shaded models, preserving reference aspect. Generated views are uncalibrated; the validation report separates named geometry checks, weighted silhouette results and remaining limits.

shadedComparison.caption: Shaded reference, previous and revised geometry. Previous/current share camera and display scale; reference aspect is preserved. Inspect panel volume, attachments and lower surfaces as well as the outline.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the back detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line (tools/vehicles/evidence).

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key (white texels tint: body and bumpers; the glass, lamps, grille, badges, black mirrors, rims and tyres keep their colour), the number on the roof (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge. paints-strip.png shows white plus five player colours. No livery: the AU has none.
